text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I burst right through the spring hurdle!
Hi-yah!
Call me
Matikan-enter-the-dragon!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Were you watching, Trainer? Fortune
smiled on
me from the heavens!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Thank you! With a race as important as this, I gave it my all—is what I would say if the gods hadn't already done the hard work for me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now it's time to see what fate has to say
about
my next race! Not that it should
be much of a
surprise.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the first stage of the Classics,
so it's
pretty obvious... But anyway, let's
start up those
divinations!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna snatch a fortune slip quick this
time. I
wonder what it'll be... Drumroll,
please!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What in the what?! The Japanese
Derby?!
Whazzat now?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Am I really supposed to just skip the
Satsuki Sho
and dive straight into the
Derby?! O gods,
enlighten me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A challenge... Yes, that must be it. The
race that
every Umamusume dreams
of—the very pinnacle
of the Classics...
choice_data_list_en: Maybe it's a trial from the heavens.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fine. If this is my destiny, I'll accept it
with open
arms! Can I ask for your
assistance?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Thank yooouuu! If you're with me, I can
at least
try.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now let's hurry and buy up some lucky
charms to
commemorate my new destiny.
Ooh, and I can get
them to stamp my
shrine passport while we're
there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: O-of course I'm going to train too. I'm sure you're aware that my efforts won't do much to change things...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But fret not... That doesn't mean I won't
put all
my strength into this. After all,
the Derby is a big
deal.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I shan't mar that sunny day! I'd like to
hang a
fortune right from one of Fuchu's
giant zelkova
trees while in good spirits!
